이름: Palgongsan National Park Dohak Campground | 팔공산국립공원 도학야영장
설명:
EN: Small national-park auto-camping ground (28 deck sites) at Dohak-dong on Palgongsan.
KNPS official: 팔공산로237길 47; office 053-984-8418. Check-in 14:00, check-out 12:00 next day. Fees: 20,000 won weekday / 30,000 won weekend & peak (peak 1 Jul–31 Aug and 1 Oct–15 Nov); electricity up to 600 W. Media-art screen runs weekdays 17:00–22:00, weekends 11:00–22:00. About 10 min walk from Suseongmot Station (Line 3). The lake itself is an open park; pin should go to the info centre, not the water.

JA: 寿城区の人気湖畔公園。
住所は公式の寿城池観光案内所（寿城池キル37、053-761-0645）基準。案内所は季節により09:00〜21:00。地下鉄3号線寿城池駅徒歩10分。

ZH: 寿城区著名的湖畔公园。
